title: The Cartographer
description: A survey of the long road north, walked and drawn by somebody who
names everything -- which is why every node on this canvas carries
its name under it, the one chapter in the collection that turns
`showTitle` on for all of its quests and spaces them wide enough
that the names never run together.
The lines are road lines: orthogonal out of the gate, a
chamfered conduit over the old bridge, a stepped climb to the
milestone, a double-ruled final approach. The camps are `location`
boxes, the trial chamber is a `structure` gate, and the last sheet
waits on a quest from another chapter group entirely -- the
underground of `first_light`, which is what a cross-group edge
looks like: the format's dependencies do not stop at the group
boundary, and this road does not stop at the survey's edge either.
The chapter answers to `the_map` as well as `the_cartographer_road`
-- a chapter alias, the middle level of the format's three.
Read it for: a fully named road, road-style `dependencyLines`,
`location` camps, the `trial_chambers` structure, a chapter alias,
and a dependency that leaves its own chapter group.
